assets.what_it_shows: Fly Geyser in the Black Rock Desert, Nevada

Fly Geyser, also known as Fly Ranch Geyser is a man-made small geothermal geyser located in Washoe County, Nevada approximately 20 miles (32 km) north of Gerlach.
